application.description: WATI WhatsApp Business API integration for sending template messages, session messages, interactive messages (buttons, lists), media attachments (images, documents, videos), managing templates, contacts and receiving inbound messages via webhooks. WATI is a no-code WhatsApp Business solution built on the official WhatsApp Business API.

auth_config.description: WATI Access Token (Bearer) from your WATI dashboard under API Docs / Integration. The token already includes the 'Bearer ' prefix when copied from WATI - remove the prefix when entering it here.

api_key.label: WATI Access Token
api_key.description: Access token from WATI Dashboard > API Docs. Do NOT include the 'Bearer ' prefix.

application.notes: Set base_url to your tenant-specific WATI endpoint. Find this in WATI Dashboard > API Docs - it looks like https://live-mt-server.wati.io/{tenant_id} where {tenant_id} is your unique tenant identifier.

webhook_config.notes: WATI's webhook UI does not allow setting custom HTTP headers, so the IOFlow invocation API key is accepted via the 'api_key' query string on the webhook URL. Append ?api_key=<your-invocation-api-key> to each webhook URL when configuring WATI.

services.description: Send a pre-approved WhatsApp template message to a single recipient. Use this to initiate conversations with end users outside the 24-hour session window.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient's WhatsApp number with country code (e.g., 919999999999)

template_name.description: Pre-approved WATI template name (must already be approved by WhatsApp)

broadcast_name.description: Name to identify this broadcast in WATI dashboard

var1.description: First template variable value (replaces {{1}} in template)

var2.description: Second template variable value (replaces {{2}} in template)

services.description: Send a pre-approved WhatsApp template message using the V2 endpoint which supports richer parameter types including header media (image/document/video) and button parameters.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient's WhatsApp number with country code

broadcast_name.description: Identifier for this broadcast in WATI dashboard

channel_number.description: Optional. WhatsApp channel number to send from (required only if account has multiple numbers)

parameters.description: Array of template parameters. Each item: {name, value} for text params, or {name, mediaUrl, fileName} for header media.

services.description: Send a pre-approved WhatsApp template message to multiple recipients in a single API call. Supports per-recipient personalized parameters.

broadcast_name.description: Identifier for this broadcast in WATI dashboard

whatsappNumber.description: Recipient's WhatsApp number with country code

customParams.description: Array of custom parameter objects for personalization

services.description: Send a custom text message during an active WhatsApp session (within the 24-hour window after user interaction). Cannot be used to initiate conversation.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient's WhatsApp number with country code (e.g., 918888888888)

message_text.description: Plain text message to send. Supports WhatsApp formatting (bold, italic, etc.)

sample_input.message_text: Hi! Thanks for reaching out. How can we help you today?

services.description: Send a media file (image, document, video, audio) by URL during an active WhatsApp session. Supports captions.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient's WhatsApp number with country code

media_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to the media file (image, document, video, audio)

caption.description: Optional caption for the media (not supported for audio)

file_name.description: File name with extension (e.g., invoice.pdf). Required for documents.

services.description: Upload and send a media file directly (multipart upload) during an active WhatsApp session. Use this when you don't have a public URL for the file.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient's WhatsApp number with country code

file_data.description: File object with data/type/name to upload

services.description: Send an interactive WhatsApp message with up to 3 quick reply buttons during an active session.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient's WhatsApp number with country code

header_text.description: Header text shown above the message body

body_text.description: Main body text of the interactive message

sample_input.body_text: Would you like to confirm your order #12345?

services.description: Send an interactive WhatsApp message with a list of selectable options during an active session.

whatsapp_number.description: Recipient's WhatsApp number with country code

body_text.description: Main body text of the message

button_text.description: Text shown on the button that opens the list (e.g., 'Select an option')

sample_input.body_text: Please choose a product category to explore

services.description: Get all approved WhatsApp message templates linked to your WATI account, with pagination support.
Fetch all contacts saved in your WATI account with pagination and optional filtering.
Add a new contact (or update an existing one) to your WATI account by WhatsApp number.

whatsapp_number.description: Contact's WhatsApp number with country code (no + sign)

custom_params.description: Optional custom attribute key/value pairs for the contact

services.description: Update custom attributes for an existing contact identified by WhatsApp number.

whatsapp_number.description: Contact's WhatsApp number with country code

custom_params.description: Custom attribute key/value pairs to set/update

services.description: Download/retrieve a media file from WATI by its filename. Used to access media files received via webhooks.

file_name.description: Filename of the media to retrieve (from webhook payload)

events.description: Triggered when a customer sends a WhatsApp message to your WATI number. Payload wraps the message in an envelope: event_id, event_name, app_id, webhook_data. Configure in WATI Dashboard > Webhooks.

webhook_setup_guide.step1: Login to the WhatsApp provider Dashboard
webhook_setup_guide.step5: Enter callback URL: your IOFlow webhook endpoint

events.description: Triggered when an outgoing WhatsApp message changes status (SENT, DELIVERED, READ, FAILED, REPLIED). Configure in WATI Dashboard > Webhooks with status events enabled.
Triggered when a user taps a quick-reply button on an interactive message. WATI delivers this via the same Message Received webhook, with the button info under interactiveButtonReply or buttonReply.
Triggered when a user selects an item from an interactive list message. Delivered via the Message Received webhook with listReply populated.
Triggered when a user sends a media file (image, document, video, audio, voice, sticker) via WhatsApp. Use the get_media service with the data field to download the file.

media_filename.description: Parameter extracted from $.data (use with get_media service to download)
